projection.coordinateTransform: UE cm = (OBJ X / 10, -OBJ Y / 10, OBJ Z / 10); OBJ source is site-centred Z-up
projection.normalMapConvention: Pinned OpenGL normal input; native normal sampler with GL-to-DX green flip exactly once, then use the same signed U,V,N basis to return world-space normal; no tangent-space output flag on world-space result.
projection.anchorPolicy: One fixed source-derived anchor for all four kitchen bodies; per-source-object anchor for tabletop and rails. Record actual anchors during implementation. No randomized offsets or source UV mutation.
projection.roundedDerivativeConstraint: Cardinal face frame table is valid for current axial source boxes only. Bevels require explicit per-chart physical UVs and corresponding tangent frames derived from actual rounded geometry; no blind dominant-axis normal snapping on the bevel. Canonical UVs remain untouched.
projection.endFaceLimit: Veneer scan is an appearance candidate, not a measured solid-oak end-grain texture; longitudinal end faces use the explicit transverse fallback and must be visually reviewed.

rounding.method: Inward rounded-box visual derivative, identical source center/orientation and full outer AABB; every vertex stays inside the source bounds. Broad planes and framed-chair design retained.
limits: No change to cabinet collision geometry; kitchen is material-only.
No seat/back incline, tufting, piping, leg shape, posture, thickness increase or moved parts.
Keep back-pad MAT_0085 material and existing fabric textures; do not put oak on upholstery.
Derivative has NoCollision and no navigation contribution; retained canonical proxies keep their exact prior collision/navigation/picking contracts.
Successful derivative asset save/reload and actual per-vertex containment proof must precede any canonical render-proxy hiding.

futureNativeGates: Exact input/source-record/material-slot guards and exact nine per-object photo bindings; preserve all remaining current bindings including three active TV overrides.
